required_human_checks: Confirm each current value before editing.
Validate each proposed value against the classroom lesson objective.
Reject any proposal that conflicts with vendor guidance or lab constraints.

settings.location_hint: HMI or engineering workstation account configuration screen
settings.operator_action: Disable, remove, or rename any default/shared accounts after confirming replacements exist.
settings.rationale: Defaults and shared credentials are high-risk in PLC environments.

settings.location_hint: HMI or engineering workstation password policy screen
settings.operator_action: Set minimum password length to at least 12 if the platform supports it.
settings.rationale: Classroom systems should still demonstrate strong password policy configuration.

settings.location_hint: HMI or engineering workstation password policy screen
settings.operator_action: Enable complexity requirements if the platform supports them.
settings.rationale: Classroom systems should still demonstrate strong password policy configuration.

settings.location_hint: Network configuration screen or supporting gateway/firewall management view
settings.operator_action: Confirm network segmentation is enabled or documented in the classroom environment.
settings.rationale: OT access should be narrowed to approved management paths.

settings.location_hint: Management access control or allowlist configuration screen
settings.operator_action: Restrict management access to the approved classroom engineering subnet.
settings.rationale: OT access should be narrowed to approved management paths.

settings.operator_action: If web management is not needed, disable it. If needed, keep it restricted to approved management paths.
settings.rationale: If a web interface exists, plaintext transport should be flagged.

settings.operator_action: Enable TLS or equivalent secure transport if web management remains enabled.
settings.rationale: If a web interface exists, plaintext transport should be flagged.

settings.operator_action: Disable Modbus if it is not needed for the classroom exercise; otherwise document and protect the path.
settings.rationale: Protocol availability should be documented and protected, especially Modbus-related paths.
